def regression_loglike(weights, beta):
    weights = np.atleast_2d(np.asarray(weights, dtype=float))
    residuals = poly_y[None, :] - weights @ reg_Phi.T
    rss = np.sum(residuals**2, axis=1)
    n = poly_y.size
    return n/2 * np.log(beta) - n/2 * np.log(2*np.pi) - beta/2 * rss
